analysis.summary: Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited (ASAL) published its 36th Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, detailing corporate information, financial highlights, notice of the Annual General Meeting, and resolutions for approval. The document outlines proposed material related party transactions with entities such as Tata Motors Limited, Tata AutoComp Hendrickson Suspensions, Fiat India Automobiles, and others. Additionally, it details remuneration revisions and cost-to-company structures for the Manager and Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Suhas Dode. The report includes regulatory disclosures, voting instructions, and explanatory statements pursuant to the Companies Act, 2013.

management_commitments.claim: The Board of Directors approved the appointment of M/s. Harshad S. Deshpande & Associates as Cost Auditors to conduct the audit of cost records for the financial year ending March 31, 2026 at a remuneration of Rs. 75,000.
management_commitments.quote: On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, the Board of Directors at their meeting held on April 25, 2025 approved the appointment of M/s. Harshad S. Deshpande & Associates, Cost Accountants (Firm Registration No.: No. 00378), as Cost Auditors of the Company for conducting the audit of the cost records of the Company, for the financial year ending March 31, 2026 at a remuneration of `75,000/- (Rupees Seventy-Five Thousand Only) plus taxes as may be applicable and reimbursement of such other out of pocket expenses, as may be incurred by them during the course of Audit.

management_commitments.claim: The Board of Directors approved the appointment of M/s. Harshad S. Deshpande & Associates as Cost Auditors for the financial year ending March 31, 2027 at a remuneration of Rs. 85,000.
management_commitments.quote: On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, the Board of Directors at their meeting held on April 25, 2026 approved the appointment of M/s. Harshad S. Deshpande & Associates, Cost Accountants (Firm Registration No.: No. 00378), as Cost Auditors of the Company for conducting the audit of the cost records of the Company, for the financial year ending March 31, 2027 at a remuneration of `85,000/- (Rupees Eighty-Five Thousand Only) plus taxes as may be applicable and reimbursement of such other out of pocket expenses, as may be incurred by them during the course of Audit.

management_commitments.claim: The company appointed M/s SVD and Associates as Secretarial Auditors for a consecutive term of 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Board of Directors of the Company, be and is hereby severally authorized to determine the remuneration of the Secretarial Auditors including the revision in the remuneration during the tenure, if any, basis the inflation, in consultation with the Secretarial Auditors, in addition to reimbursement of all out-of-pocket expenses, to be incurred by them in connection with the Secretarial Audit and to file necessary forms with Registrar of Companies and to do all such acts, deeds and things, as may be necessary, to give effect to this resolution.

management_commitments.claim: The remuneration terms for Mr. Suhas Dode, Manager designated as Chief Executive Officer, are revised effective from April 01, 2025 till April 30, 2028.
management_commitments.quote: consent of the Members of the Company be and is hereby accorded to revise the Terms of remuneration of Mr. Suhas Dode, Manager designated as Chief Executive Officer of the Company, by way of increase in the amount of basic salary payable to Mr. Suhas Dode, (including the remuneration to be paid in the event of loss or inadequacy of profits in any financial year during the tenure of his appointment) and fixation of scale with authority to the Board of Directors (hereinafter referred to as the ‘Board’, which term shall be deemed to include any Committee of the Board constituted to exercise its powers, including the powers conferred by this Resolution) to fix his salary within such maximum amount, increasing thereby, proportionately, all benefits related to the quantum of salary, w.e.f. April 01, 2025 till April 30, 2028 on such Terms and Conditions as set out in the Explanatory Statement annexed to the Notice convening this Meeting.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
